versions.changelog: Description tail link + agents machine-readable metadata line (deciqai.com/s/mortgage-loan-program-matching.json)

- Initial release of mortgage-loan-program-matching skill.
- Activates when matching borrowers to specific loan programs (Conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, Jumbo, Non-QM) or deciding between fixed and ARM options.
- Maps borrower attributes (credit, DTI, LTV, down payment, property type, eligibility) to eligible programs and compares total cost and approval odds.
- Includes compliance anchors and verification checklist for fair, documented presentation of loan options.
- Provides worked example and references to practical tools for loan officers and brokerages.
- Designed to support decision-tree driven mortgage program selection; does not constitute lending advice.
